about.title: Our Philosophy
about.introduction: Timeless Biblical Wisdom for Today's Marketplace.

sections.title: Ancient principles. Thoughtful decisions. Responsible business.
sections.body: Business Nuggets from the Bible connects biblical teaching with the questions executives face: how to lead, steward resources, plan wisely and act with character. The aim is reflection that informs responsible action—not a shortcut to success.

sections.title: Proverbs 11:1
sections.body: “A false balance is an abomination to the Lord, but a just weight is his delight.”

sections.title: Read Scripture in Context
sections.body: Begin with the passage, its setting and its meaning. Business application should remain distinguishable from the biblical text.

sections.title: Steward Resources Responsibly
sections.body: Treat capital, time and entrusted work as responsibilities. Consider risks, obligations and the people affected by each decision.

sections.title: Lead with Integrity
sections.body: Honest measures and transparent terms matter. Seek fairness in agreements, accountability in leadership and respect in relationships.

sections.title: Apply with Discernment
sections.body: Commentary and cinematic musicals offer ways to explore a principle. They do not replace Scripture, professional advice or your responsibility to evaluate a decision. Consult qualified legal, financial or other advisers where appropriate, and do not interpret a teaching as a promise of commercial results.

sections.title: Find an answer

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.introduction: A few answers to help you find your way around Business Nuggets.

sections.title: What is Business Nuggets?
sections.body: Business Nuggets from the Bible brings together biblical principles and practical business commentary for personal study and reflection.

sections.title: How do I find a nugget?
sections.body: Open The Library to browse nuggets, topics, challenges, Scripture Index and collections. Use the search and filters to find a subject or passage.

sections.title: Why should I create an account?
sections.body: An account gives you access to your personal workspace, where you can organize saved nuggets, playlists and notes.

sections.title: How do I reset my password?
sections.body: Choose Forgot password on the Login page and follow the instructions sent to your email address.

sections.title: Where do I manage my profile?
sections.body: Sign in and open Account Settings from the account menu to manage your profile and available account preferences.

sections.title: Is all content free?
sections.body: Some content may require a membership. Check the access requirements and current plan details before subscribing.

sections.title: Where can I read the privacy policy and terms?
sections.body: Use the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use links in the footer. These pages explain the platform’s published policies.
